messages:
alice.m: paging — alert: p99 latency spike on /v1/chat/stream for several clusters, looks correlated with heavy prompt templates + JSON mode parsing. customers reporting stalled streams :grimacing:
incident-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: latency_slo_breach detected on service=prompt-preproc env=prod severity=P1 thread=1950000001
oncall-anna: I'm oncall, taking lead. @ben_o can you pull p95/p99 histograms and stack traces?
ben_o: grabbing metrics now. quick numbers: baseline p95 ~120ms, p99 ~400ms. right now p95 ~430ms, p99 ~1.7s on region-us-east-1 for model-route "redwood-3b-quant". streaming stall count up 6x.
carlos: seeing preproc CPU at 93% on tokenizer-worker-*. queue length for tokenizer parse jobs spiked from ~30 -> ~820. JSON mode parser threads show GC pauses aligned with spikes.
oncall-anna: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable JSON-mode parsing at router for streaming route 2) route a fraction to fallback lightweight model 3) scale preproc tokenizer workers 4) coordinate rolling restart if needed. assigning tasks now.
ben_o: disabling JSON mode on router for route /v1/chat/stream -> done (policy flag toggled). will route 20% traffic to redwood-3b-quant-lite.
alice.m: customer impact: support reports 4 customers with streaming timeouts and ~1.2% of requests returning 504s in last 10m. highest impact: customers using heavy tool schemas / nested JSON templates.
support-ryan: filing incident notice to affected customers now, tagging enterprise CS for outreach.
carlos: increasing tokenizer preproc replica count from 3 -> 6 (HPA didn't scale fast enough due to sudden CPU burst). scaling started.
ben_o: started rolling restart of tokenizer pods to clear bad GC state: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/tokenizer-preproc -n prod` — will do staggered 30s between pods.
oncall-anna: good. also enabling KV prefix cache bypass for streaming so we avoid large prefix reserializations for templates.
ben_o: metrics after toggles: p95 down to ~210ms, p99 down to ~780ms, streaming stalls reduced by ~60%. tokenizer queue dropping. still some tails at p99 ~900-1k while restarts finish.
alice.m: note — disabling JSON mode will degrade structured output for some tool-heavy prompts; we'll revert when preproc stabilizes. keep monitoring for errors.
support-ryan: updated customers: short advisory sent, included mitigation steps and ETA for full fix. no major data loss, just latency/timeouts.
carlos: after restart, one pod failed readiness probe and crashed due to oom. investigating; bumping memory limit on next pod.
ben_o: manually scaled one extra pod to replace crashed one and adjusted requests/limits locally. new pod healthy.
oncall-anna: next steps: 1) investigate parser memory leak in JSON mode 2) add guardrails to router to auto-disable JSON-mode on latency spikes 3) postmortem + RCA + action items 4) consider prompt-template size limits and clearer doc for customers
alice.m: adding short-term action: add a soft reject for templates > 120KB on streaming route to stop runaway templates until we fix parser.
carlos: collecting heap dumps from tokenizer-worker that crashed — uploading to /artifacts/1950000001/heapdump-1.hprof
ben_o: capture: `curl -s http://metrics/api/query?service=prompt-preproc&from=now-30m` then grab p95/p99. attaching snapshot to incident channel.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress. severity=P1 -> currently degraded. next update in 10m or on status change.
oncall-anna: handing off to @ben_o for night watch in case of recurrence, I'll draft postmortem later. great coordination team :thumbsup:
ben_o: got it — will watch for 2hrs, will escalate if p99 > 1s again.
alice.m: reticketing to eng-ml for parser memory leak and to eng-runtime for router auto-toggle feature.
support-ryan: closing customer advisory loop for now; will reopen if errors spike.
carlos: logging follow-ups: add more granular timers around JSON parse path, add needle profiler for GC.
oncall-anna: last check before handoff: p95=180ms, p99=620ms, stalls near baseline. moving to monitoring state. thanks all.
ben_o: final note for handoff: watch for correlated deploys or config changes in next 2 hours — our mitigation is config-based so new deploys could re-enable JSON mode.
alice.m: thanks everyone. postmortem owners: carlos (root cause), ben_o (mitigation/playbook), alice.m (customer comms). incident closed for active paging at 1950000360.
